draft_en.subject: PoE switches for the LVswitch and Grandstream rollouts - 8-port managed and a budget unit
draft_en.body:
Hello CloudItNetwork team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 25 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches that go out with LVswitch PBXs and Grandstream phones, neutral-brand units at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed with VLAN and QoS for voice, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD; budget unmanaged 8 x PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit - STC-028GP - $25.1; 16 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed - STC-2216GPM - $141.7.

One question: which port count do your VoIP installs use most - 8 or 16?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
